{{Quote|You're about as much fun as a swampful of venom rats!|Wicket Wystri Warrick|<ref name="Ewoks5" />}}
A '''venom rat''' was a type of [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Rat/Legends|rat]] that could be found in [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]].<ref name="Ewoks5" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 5|''Ewoks'' 5]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] fled from the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] woodsmen [[Rok]] and [[Zol]] after discovering the alien's plot of cutting down the Ewok's [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on the<ref name="Ewoks5" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] for processing. During the chase, Wicket stated that the two aliens were as fun as a swampful of venom rats.<ref name="Ewoks5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Venom rats were mentioned in the [[Ewoks (1985) 5|fifth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Star Wars: Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was written by [[David Manak]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="Ewoks5" /> on [[October 1]], [[1985]].<ref name="Release">''[[Marvel Age]]'' 32</ref>
